boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten no-cost, under-21-safe stops for a self-guided visit to the USMMA grounds.

cards.title: Browse the maritime museum
cards.subtitle: USMMA grounds, Kings Point
cards.notes: Meet at the museum entrance, then compare the artifacts and maritime-history displays at your own pace. Confirm the Academy’s operating status before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A public-facing museum stop centered on Academy and merchant-marine history.
cards.evidence_claim: USMMA says the museum preserves and interprets historic artifacts and artwork, and its visitor page states that Academy grounds and the museum are open to the public during normal operations; tours carry no charge.
cards.source_title: Visiting USMMA | U.S. Merchant Marine Academy
cards.access_notes: Public access is subject to normal Academy operations, federal holidays, and leave periods; check the academic calendar and confirm operating status before visiting.

cards.title: Pause at the Mariners' Memorial Chapel
cards.subtitle: USMMA grounds, Kings Point
cards.notes: Walk over together to view the chapel’s memorial architecture and discuss the Roll of Honor. Contact the chapel before planning interior access or a service visit.
cards.short_summary: A national memorial dedicated to merchant mariners lost in wartime.
cards.evidence_claim: USMMA identifies Mariners' Memorial Chapel as a National Memorial honoring Merchant Marine members who died at sea during World Wars I and II; Academy tours have no charge.
cards.source_title: History | Mariners' Memorial Chapel | U.S. Merchant Marine Academy
cards.access_notes: The chapel is a listed visitor contact point. Coordinate access with the chapel and visit only while the Academy is open for normal operations.

cards.title: Find Wiley Hall on a grounds walk
cards.subtitle: USMMA grounds, Kings Point
cards.notes: Use the campus map from the security gate to locate Wiley Hall, then take in the exterior as part of a self-guided group walk around the Academy grounds.
cards.short_summary: A named Academy building that works as an exterior landmark on a free campus walk.
cards.evidence_claim: USMMA’s visitor guidance welcomes visitors during normal operations, provides for self-guided tours of the grounds, and states that tours have no charge; USMMA identifies Wiley Hall in its commencement schedule.
cards.source_title: Visiting USMMA | U.S. Merchant Marine Academy
cards.access_notes: Exterior stop only unless separately authorized. Obtain the campus map at the security gate and confirm operating status before arrival.

cards.title: Meet up at Barney Square
cards.subtitle: USMMA grounds, Kings Point
cards.notes: Make Barney Square the regrouping point for a self-guided walk, then continue toward another map-listed landmark. Keep clear of any Academy event setup or restricted area.
cards.short_summary: An identifiable outdoor gathering point on the Academy grounds.
cards.evidence_claim: USMMA’s visitor guidance permits self-guided tours of the grounds and says tours have no charge; a current Academy commencement schedule identifies Barney Square by name.
cards.source_title: Visiting USMMA | U.S. Merchant Marine Academy
cards.access_notes: Use as an outdoor, self-guided grounds stop only during normal Academy operations. Check the calendar and security instructions first.

cards.title: Stop by Tomb Field
cards.subtitle: USMMA grounds, Kings Point
cards.notes: Walk to the field as a named outdoor waypoint and look for the day’s athletic or campus activity from permitted public areas. Do not enter scheduled practices or events.
cards.short_summary: A named Academy athletic field used for major campus ceremonies and sports.
cards.evidence_claim: USMMA’s visitor guidance allows no-charge self-guided tours of the grounds, and its 2026 commencement schedule names Tomb Field as the planned ceremony location.
cards.source_title: Visiting USMMA | U.S. Merchant Marine Academy
cards.access_notes: View from permitted outdoor areas during normal operations; event access and field access can vary, so follow posted and security directions.

cards.title: Circle Powell Oval
cards.subtitle: USMMA grounds, Kings Point
cards.notes: Add a loop around Powell Oval to a self-guided route and use it as a spot to compare campus-map directions before moving to the next landmark.
cards.short_summary: A named outdoor Academy landmark suitable for an exterior walking stop.
cards.evidence_claim: USMMA’s visitor guidance welcomes visitors during normal operations, offers self-guided tours of the grounds, and says tours have no charge; USMMA names Powell Oval in its 2026 commencement schedule.
cards.source_title: Visiting USMMA | U.S. Merchant Marine Academy
cards.access_notes: Outdoor self-guided stop only. Obtain a campus map at the security gate and avoid areas reserved for Academy activities.

cards.title: Check out O'Hara Hall's exterior
cards.subtitle: USMMA grounds, Kings Point
cards.notes: Locate O’Hara Hall on the self-guided route and talk through the range of sports it supports while viewing the building from approved grounds areas.
cards.short_summary: The Academy’s indoor athletic facility, recognizable as a campus activity landmark.
cards.evidence_claim: USMMA describes O'Hara Hall as a historic indoor athletic facility with a gymnasium, Olympic-size pool and diving well, courts, and training areas; no-charge self-guided grounds tours are available.
cards.access_notes: Treat this as an exterior stop unless the Academy authorizes facility entry. Campus access is limited to normal operations and may change for events.

cards.title: See the Yocum Sailing Center
cards.subtitle: USMMA waterfront, Kings Point
cards.notes: Walk to the waterfront-facing center with friends and take in the building and shoreline setting from permitted grounds. Respect all waterfront barriers and operations.
cards.short_summary: A named waterfront hub for Academy rowing and sailing teams.
cards.evidence_claim: USMMA says Yocum Sailing Center overlooks Little Neck Bay and serves as the home base for its rowing, dinghy sailing, and offshore sailing teams; self-guided Academy grounds tours have no charge.
cards.access_notes: Exterior viewing only unless separately authorized. Follow waterfront safety controls and confirm the Academy is open before visiting.

cards.title: Add Bland Library to the route
cards.subtitle: USMMA grounds, Kings Point
cards.notes: Use Bland Library as a named waypoint on the grounds walk and snap an exterior photo with your group. Ask staff before assuming public access to interior services.
cards.short_summary: A named Academy library building on the Kings Point campus.
cards.evidence_claim: USMMA’s Campus Modernization Plan identifies Bland Library as an Academy facility; USMMA’s visitor guidance provides no-charge self-guided tours of the grounds.
cards.source_title: Visiting USMMA | U.S. Merchant Marine Academy
cards.access_notes: Exterior self-guided stop only unless library staff authorize entry. Pick up the campus map at the security gate and verify operating status.

cards.title: Spot Samuels Hall on campus
cards.subtitle: USMMA grounds, Kings Point
cards.notes: Find Samuels Hall with the campus map, pause for an exterior photo, and continue the route through permitted public grounds without entering academic spaces.
cards.short_summary: A named Academy academic building and clear self-guided-tour waypoint.
cards.evidence_claim: USMMA’s Campus Modernization Plan identifies Samuels Hall as an Academy facility; its visitor guidance allows no-charge self-guided tours of the grounds during normal operations.
cards.source_title: Visiting USMMA | U.S. Merchant Marine Academy
cards.access_notes: Exterior stop only unless separately authorized. Campus access is subject to normal operations, holidays, leave periods, and security directions.
